mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop_order (shop_id, platform, platform_order_id, order_status, fulfillment_channel, order_time, paid_time, buyer_note, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_country, receiver_state, receiver_city, receiver_address, receiver_zip, currency, exchange_rate, order_amount, shipping_fee, discount_amount, raw_json) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{platform}, #{platformOrderId}, #{orderStatus}, #{fulfillmentChannel}, #{orderTime}, #{paidTime}, #{buyerNote}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverCountry}, #{receiverState}, #{receiverCity}, #{receiverAddress}, #{receiverZip}, #{currency}, #{exchangeRate}, #{orderAmount}, #{shippingFee}, #{discountAmount}, #{rawJson}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_status = new.order_status, fulfillment_channel = new.fulfillment_channel, order_time = new.order_time, paid_time = new.paid_time, buyer_note = new.buyer_note, receiver_name = new.receiver_name, receiver_phone = new.receiver_phone, receiver_country = new.receiver_country, receiver_state = new.receiver_state, receiver_city = new.receiver_city, receiver_address = new.receiver_address, receiver_zip = new.receiver_zip, currency = new.currency, exchange_rate = new.exchange_rate, order_amount = new.order_amount, shipping_fee = new.shipping_fee, discount_amount = new.discount_amount, raw_json = new.raw_json
